findings.document_title: 13491. Preparation of extracellular matrix modified tissue engineered nerve grafts for peripheral nerve injury repair.txt
findings.source_sentence: At one or two weeks post surgery, animals are transcardially perfused, and the regenerated nerve segments are then harvested and cut into sections.

separate_issues.issue: 原 Gold are with reference to 丢失主谓 described，应修复原条目，不直接当第二事实加一。
